Абсолютно новый проект на ТВ-3! Он живет уединенно в лесу, вдали от городской суеты и волнений. Но его деревянный дом, полный света и тепла, становится маяком для всякого, кто потерял надежду и заблудился в лабиринте жизни. Ведь он тот, кто видит судьбу...

Программа Порча, которую можете смотреть онлайн - это докудрама о реальных жизненных ситуациях. Иногда в окружении появляется тот, кто желает зла настолько, что не остановится ни перед чем. Зависть, ненависть и другие негативные чувства толкают людей к контакту со сверхъестественным. И в нашей жизни наступает черная полоса. Мы задаемся вопросом: почему все валится из рук, преследуют несчастья, болезни и невезение в любви и браке? Ответ на этот вопрос может быть простым, но зловещим: на вас навели порчу. Смотрите онлайн докудраму Порча на телеканале Домашний, в которой герои обращаются к Тамаре - женщине, обладающей сверхъестественными способностями. Она может увидеть, есть ли на человеке отметка тьмы, и помочь отвести беду. В каждом выпуске программы будет воссоздан реальный случай из практики Тамары - когда отчаявшиеся люди обращались к ней за помощью. Тамара расскажет, как узнать, что на вас навели порчу, и что делать, если это действительно произошло. На официальном сайте телеканала Домашний вы можете смотреть онлайн все серии докудрамы Порча в хорошем качестве.

Zemes iedzīvotājam Arturam Dentam šī nav pati labākā diena viņa mūžā. Viņa māja tika nojaukta, viņa labākais draugs izrādās esam citplanētietis un pats galvenais - planētu Zemi ir plānots iznīcināt, jo tā traucē starpgalaktiska apvedceļa izbūvei. Artura vienīgā iespēja izdzīvot ir ielēkt garāmbraucošajā kosmosa kuģī - tā līdz ar pasaules beigām iesākas jaunizceptā kosmosa ceļotāja lielākais piedzīvojums. Galaktikas ceļojuma laikā ir iespējams beidzot noskaidrot dzīves jēgu un atklāt, ka visu, ko dzīvē nepieciešams zināt, var atrast grāmatā "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem".

На удалённом острове гениальный миллиардер Джон Хаммонд создаёт уникальный тематический парк с клонированными динозаврами. Перед открытием он приглашает учёных и юриста для инспекции. Однако система безопасности даёт сбой, и доисторические хищники вырываются на свободу. Начинается борьба за выживание.

Varonīgajam pūdelim Fredijam Lupēnam ir viss nepieciešamais, lai kļūtu par vilku bara vadoni. Viss, izņemot pārējo cieņu. Ja vien viņš būtu mazliet vairāk… vilks. Taču, kad nejauša vēlēšanās viņu pārvērš par vilku un uz Zemes nonāk palaidnīgs Mēness gars, Fredijam jāatjauno kosmiskais līdzsvars, pirms Zeme un Mēness saduras! Viena lieta ir skaidra: Fredijs vairs nekad nešaubīsies par to, ka ir īsts pūdelis!

Pavisam tuva nākotne. Globālā sasilšana un siltumnīcas efekts ir noveduši pie neskaitāmām, postošām katastrofām visā pasaulē — viesuļvētrām, zemestrīcēm un plūdiem. Šķiet, ka ir sācies jauns ledus laikmets. Zinātniekam Džekam Hallam ir jācenšas glābt ne vien pasaule, bet arī paša dēls, kurš atrodas citā pilsētā. Laikā, kad visi dodas uz dienvidiem, lai bēgtu no stindzinošā aukstuma, doktors Halls ir vienīgais, kam jātiek uz ziemeļiem.

Aleksandra Dimā leģendārā vēsturiskā piedzīvojumu romāna ekranizācijas pirmā daļa stāsta par jauno gaskonieti D'Artanjanu, kurš ierodas Parīzē un nejauši iepazīstas ar trim nešķiramiem draugiem – musketieriem Atosu, Portosu un Aramisu. Drīz vien četrotne tiek iesaistīta galma intrigās un bīstamos piedzīvojumos.

Nikolass Keidžs jūtas radoši nepiepildīts un atrodas bankrota priekšā, tomēr cer iegūt lomu jaunākajā Tarantino filmā. Lai nopelnītu miljonu dolāru, viņš piekrīt piedalīties sava fana miljardiera dzimšanas dienas ballītē. Drīz vien Keidžu savervē CIP aģente, lai ar aktiera palīdzību iegūtu informāciju par šo bagātnieku - narkotiku karteļa vadoni. Situācija vēl vairāk sarežģās, kad ballītē ierodas Keidža bijusī sieva un meita.

"Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

Pie skatītājiem ar skaudriem dzīvesstāstiem un cerībām par labāku nākotni atgriežas sociālais projekts "Caur ērkšķiem uz..."! Arī septītās sezonas dalībnieces liktenis nav žēlojis - nespēja tikt galā ar atkarībām no alkohola un narkotikām, vardarbība un atņemtas bērnu aprūpes tiesības ir tikai dažas no grūtībām, ar kurām dalībnieces saskaras. Palīdzīgu roku jaunas dzīves sākumam sniegs pieredzējuši profesionāļi un ilggadējais raidījuma vadītājs Jānis Bukums, kā arī TV ekrānā atgriežas raidījuma vadītāja Liene Stepena!

Fins ir dārgumu meklētājs, kurš vienmēr iepinas nepatikšanās un nokavē pat savu šķiršanās prāvu, jo kāds klients mēģina viņu nogalināt. Tesa ir cilvēks, kuram dēkas un piedzīvojumi ir visai sveši, un vairāk par visu viņa vēlētos mieru un kārtību ģimenē - tas arī bija abu galvenais šķiršanās iemesls. Taču, kad tiek uzietas pēdas vairākus gadsimtus atpakaļ pazudušajai spāņu dārglietu flotilei, viņi nejauši apvienojas un tiek ierauti gan smieklīgos, gan bīstamos piedzīvojumos, meklējot bagātības.

Toms Henks uz patiesiem notikumiem balstītajā stāstā par kuģa nolaupīšanu pie Somālijas krastiem. 2009. gada aprīlī kravas kuģis Maersk Alabama kapteiņa Ričarda Filipsa vadībā devās uz Mombasas ostu Kenijā, šķērsojot Adenas līci pie Somālijas krastiem. Bruņoti somālieši ieņēma kuģi un, saņēmuši gūstā kuģa kapteini Filipsu, pieprasīja izpirkuma maksu. Dreifējot glābšanas laivā kopā ar sagūstītājiem necilvēcīgos apstākļos, aci pret aci ar pirātu vadoni Musē, Filipsam atlika tikai cerēt uz brīnumu. Ar pirātiem kopā pavadītajā laikā kapteinis atskārst, ka noziedznieku motīvi nemaz nav tik viennozīmīgi. Filmas scenārijs balstīts uz kapteiņa Filipsa biogrāfiskās grāmatas pamata.

Lai padarītu dzīvi nedaudz jautrāku un pozitīvāku, Karls metis sev izaicinājumu uz visu atbildēt ar "jā" . Arī tajos brīžos, kad daudz saprātīgāk būtu teikt nē! Šī apņemšanās, protams, paver durvis smieklīgiem pārpratumiem un komiskām likstām.

Neiznīcināmajiem ceļā stājies pats Konrads Stounbenkss, kas pirms daudziem gadiem kopā ar Bārniju radījis neiznīcināmo komandu. Reiz krietnais vīrs tagad kļuvis par negodīgu darboni un tirgo ieročus, lai iedzīvotos. Bārnijs saņēmis pavēli viņu novākt un domā, ka ir to izdarījis. Taču Stounbenkss, nosvinējis pats savas bēres, atkal parādās atklātībā. Viņš atgriežas, lai izrēķinātos ar neiznīcināmajiem. Bārnijam ir citi nodomi. Cīņā ar seniem ienaidniekiem viņš nolēmis iesaistīt svaigus spēkus un uzņem neiznīcināmo komandā jaunus, veiklus, kaujas tehniku apguvušus profesionāļus. Šis neiznīcināmo uzdevums pārvēršas par izrādi - vecā gvarde mācās no jaunajiem, kam cīņā palīdz augstās tehnoloģijas.

Džons Travolta, Keita Bosvorta un Šārona Stouna drāmā par vīriem, kas ik dienu pavada uz dzīvības un nāves robežas. Bo un viņa uzticamā komanda ir elektriķi - vīri, kas ikdienā uztur elektrisko tīklu. Darbs lielā augstumā pie vadiem, kas satur 500 000 voltu elektrības, bieži vien ir tikai sekundes un milimetrus no traģēdijas. Bo brālis gāja bojā no elektrības strāvās, tāpēc Bo ir apņēmības pilns turēt pa gabalu no šī bīstamā darba savu brāļa meitu Beiliju un sūtīt viņu mācīties koledžā. Kad pilsēta nonāk tieši nāvējošas vētras viducī, Bo ar komandu riskē ar dzīvībām, lai uzturētu elektrotīklus kārtībā.

Mistikas trilleris par cilvēka lielākajām bailēm. Pols Konrojs strādā par kravas mašīnas vadītāju Irākā. Kādu dienu pēc irākiešu uzbrukuma viņš atjēdzas sešas pēdas zem zemes. Pārvarējis pirmo paniku, viņš zārkā atrod mobilo telefonu un šķiltavas, taču nerod atbildi, kā un kādēļ viņš šeit nonācis. Tumstoša apziņa, strauji sarūkošas mobilā telefona baterijas iedaļas un ierobežots skābekļa daudzums ir Pola lielākie ienaidnieki sacensībā ar laiku. Panikas un izmisuma pārņemtajam vīrietim atvēlētas vien 90 minūtes, lai izglābtos no šausminošas nosmakšanas.

Šo notikumu jo īpašāku padara tas, ka pirmā raidījuma viešņa ir Roberto īpaši tuva un mīļa skatuves māksliniece Marija Naumova. Marijas dziedātājas talants komentārus neprasa, viņas samtainais balss tembrs ir atpazīstams arī pasaulē un reiz Latvijai atnesis uzvaru Eirovīzijas konkursā. Marija kā personība ir ļoti vieda un emocionāla. Sarunā tiks nobirdināta neviena vien asara, runājot par Marijas attiecībām ar tēti un audžumeitu. Paldies Marijai saka viņas skatuves partnere un draudzene Līga Robežniece. Abu mākslinieču satikšanās aizkustinās līdz asarām.

Panda vārdā Po, pazīstams arī kā Pūķa Cīnītājs, ir slavens ar īpašajām cīņas mākslas prasmēm, ar ko viņš uzveicis pasaules līmeņa ļaundarus. Po piedzīvojumi turpinās - viņš trenējas, aizsargā, cīnās, māca, apmāca, reizēm klūp, bieži vien pārāk daudz runā un arī izklaidējas. Po tagad dzīvo Miera ielejā, kazarmās kopā ar saviem uzticamajiem draugiem - Nikno piecinieku, un piedzīvojumu viņiem netrūkst!

Po tagad dzīvo Miera ielejā, kazarmās kopā ar saviem uzticamajiem draugiem - Nikno piecinieku, un piedzīvojumu viņiem netrūkst!

Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens - tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram - tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē "Viens pret visiem" spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi - slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam - būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

Šonedēļ raidījumā "Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas" pie viena galda satiksies bārmenis Mārtiņš Rozenvalds, realitātes šova zvaigzne Vita Valtere, aktieris Kaspars Zāle un rakstniece Dace Rukšāne. Šo nedēļu ar savām vakariņām atklās Mārtiņš, kurš viesiem būs sarūpējis šefpavāra cienīgu maltīti un tās gatavošanā rosījies līdz pat četriem rītā. Taču vai ieguldītais darbs būs pa prātam visiem viesiem? Vakara izklaidē viesi ar neredzētas aparatūras palīdzību sacerēs paši savas dziesmas un kārtīgi iztrakosies. Savukārt desertā Mārtiņš būs sagatavojis ne vien ēdamās, bet arī dzeramās "siera kūkas", kuras iecerēts pasniegt ārā. Vai vakara izskaņā negaidītie laikapstākļi izbojās pasākuma noslēgumu?

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Losandželosas slepkavību izmeklētājs leitnants Kolumbo varbūt ir necils pēc izskata un uzvedības - vienkārši ģērbies, kluss un pieklājīgs, skumji smēķē savu cigāru. Tomēr šī neievērojamā āriene slēpj, iespējams, neatlaidīgāko un drosmīgāko izmeklētāju pilsētā. Tieši Kolumbo tiek iedalītas skaļākās un sarežģītākās lietas, kurās iesaistīts Losandželosas pilsētas zieds - slavenie, bagātie un ietekmīgie. Ieraugot Kolumbo, vainīgie bieži jūtas uzjautrināti un drošībā - šis vīrs nebūs spējīgs viņus izskaitļot. Kolumbo pierādīs pretējo!

Ar 4x labāku un ātrāku autiņu atgriezies pats slavenākais, izveicīgākais un jautrākais Francijas taksists. Viņš tā vien alkst pēc piedzīvojumiem un adrenalīna piepildītas pakaļdzīšanās. Un ko prasi, tas taps dots. Taksistam Danielam kopā ar policistu Emiljēnu jādodas krievu mafijai pa pēdām! Bez prasītājiem piedzīvojumiem neiztikt.

p.t: The Final Days of Planet Earth
p.d: When the tragic team of astronauts enlisted to excavate the moon returns to earth, it brings with it an alien-insect race that must harvest human bodies for survival. As their underground colony thrives, so does the fear that mankind's end has arrived.

p.t: The Final Days of Planet Earth
p.d: Lloyd Walker is an anti-heroic archaeologist who, after stumbling upon an alien conspiracy, becomes enmeshed in an against-all-odds battle to save the human race. Part 2/2.

American science fiction series centering on human astronaut John Crichton as the fate of the Peacekeeper race rests on his shoulders. Brought back by the Peacekeeper Alliance, Crichton is their last hope when a monstrous war is waged by the sinister Scarran Empire, and the resilient astronaut must do all he can to protect the people from being destroyed, and the universe from being consumed by the plans of the evil empire. The two-part series follows on from the original Farscape series which, after its cancellation, was left needing to be brought to a conclusion.

Family drama in which a young woman in 1950s America has her strong religious belief challenged by a series of traumatic events. The woman becomes involved with a local pastor, but her faith is tested when he is sent to serve in Korea.

The Davis family saga continues as Missie's romance with a wealthy surveyor is interrupted by her father's life-threatening accident. However, a stranger who begins helping them makes Missie second-guess her feelings.

p.t: The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
p.d: A fading actress's life is turned upside down when her rich husband dies unexpectedly while they are in Italy, and she sets off in a series of fleeting affairs set up by an ageing contessa.

Already taking a gamble settling in the uncharted west, the peaceful settlers of a town destined for railroad greatness suddenly find themselves being ruthlessly gunned down. With no law and order to be found, justice falls onto the shoulders of an elderly rancher (played by Ernest Borgnine) and an accomplished, but retired, gunslinger (played by Casper Van Dien).
Family drama with Peter Fonda. In a small, dying town, the residents' faith is tested when a statue of Jesus seems to be shedding real tears of blood.

A serial killer whose signature was "Gone But Not Forgotten" reappears years after the last murder. A local defense attorney begins to suspect that she may be the next victim and that her latest client may somehow be involved.

A serial killer whose signature read "Gone but not forgotten" resurfaces years after his last murder. A local lawyer begins to suspect that she herself may be the next victim and that her latest client may somehow be involved.
Romantic comedy starring Scott Wolf and Amanda Detmer. Two thirty-ish New Yorkers keep bumping into each other but lack the courage to become better acquainted.

Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

The pandas in the Wolong Panda Reserve in China have been followed by camera teams for a year. Thanks to the pioneering research performed at the reserve, 16 cubs have been born.

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

Preparations for winter are underway in Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. In less than three weeks, the refuge will be covered in snow, making transport and hunting near impossible. Bob prepares his gear for the first hunt of the season but runs into trouble when his boat engine malfunctions. Heimo spots a gigantic bull moose - the one animal that can provide enough meat for himself and his wife throughout the entire winter. After tracking the animal to a gravel bar, Heimo deploys his signature moose call to draw it out into the open. Later, a fourth family - Tyler and Ashley Selden - arrive at their cabin to find it flooded by a rising river. After working to catch nearly 400 salmon, the young couple is forced to go on the offensive after a bear ransacks their fish pile and threatens the only means of keeping their dog team fed through winter.
Owners Lisa and Callu are worried about Merlin, a Great Dane who goes over on his front toes when he walks. Neurologist Annette Wessman suspects a problem in his spine or skull.

Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm
p.d: When a rare EF-3 tornado hits northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos as 150 mph winds disintegrate shopping centers, toss vehicles and carve a path of destruction through a city that never saw it coming.

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm
p.d: In 2024, hundreds of cameras capture back-to-back hurricanes slamming Florida's Gulf Coast. Just as Category 4 Hurricane Helene brings record flooding, residents have no chance to recover before Category 3 Hurricane Milton unleashes over 40 tornadoes.

Tormented by childhood childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body. A sailor captures lights over the Pacific Ocean that he believes are alien craft, and a couple finds unusual footprints in the woods.

The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo…. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse…. Or the quick footed pronghorn… Which is the fastest over land? CHEETAH On the mighty expanse of the African savannahs a battle has been raging and evolving for millions of years. The race between predator/prey can reach astonishing speeds. PRONGHORN The fastest animal in the western hemisphere - the Pronghorn, flies across the prairies of North America. With its elegant loping run covering 6 meters with each stride the pronghorn can sustain speeds of 60 km/hr and can reach a top speed of almost one hundred. WILDEBEEST Wildebeest, the iconic roaming antelopes of the African plains, these bearded, shaggy maned and horned animals are among natures best endurance runners. Calves learn to walk within minutes of birth and can keep up with the herd within days. KANGAROO The diverse landscapes of Australia are home an alert, curious and enigmatic animal, the world's largest and fastest marsupial - the mighty kangaroo. BRUMBY Wild horses are truly a symbol of majestic power: strong , sleek elegant - the ultimate untamable free spirit, galloping unbridled across the land. Almost a million Brumbies grace Australia's landscapes. The powerful galloping horse, the mighty hopping kangaroo, the endurance running wildebeest, the bounding pronghorn or the sprinting cheetah, which one is the most impressive across land?

Which one is the most dangerous? LION Giraffes are eternally majestic, buffalo formidable, but with their golden fur, regal mane and fearsome presence lions are known as the "King of Beasts" SCORPIONS A barely habitable burnt corner of the earth, parched and sun drenched... Once the sun has set and temperatures drop, the night time wilderness becomes a very dangerous place. Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Predator versus prey: in this instalment we analyze three attack-escape scenarios involving bird predators and their prey. One is the climbing flight escape, another is horizontal speeding, and thirdly, there is turning and diving to avoid capture. Predator and prey attack-escape behaviour is another outcome of the evolutionary arms race. There is something about birds of prey that make us pay attention - maybe it is the inherent fear we all have that one will attack us - or perhaps it is just because they are seldom seen by most westerners. Regardless, birds of prey are fascinating and in this episode we examine of some of the largest, mightiest and most spectacular raptors from around the world. We'll watch with fascination the Eagle, a large bird of prey that is a skilled hunter and highly efficient killer. These elegant predators do their best work in large open spaces, where they can fly high and see for miles and miles. Meanwhile, the fastest living animal on land, sea or sky is also a bird of prey. The peregrine falcon can be found from the arctic to the tropics, and for centuries has been a symbol of prestige. At the other end of the scale is a bird that strips a carcass.

How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity…

February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

Learn all there is to know about the deep blue sea with dynamic naturalist and underwater photographer Jonathan Bird. Co-produced by Jonathan Bird Productions and the non-profit organisation Oceanic Research Group, this show provides a fun and engaging learning platform, educating the viewers about all things underwater, including animal stories, marine research, recent discoveries and stunning underwater photography. A true family favourite, Jonathan Bird's Big Blue World is easily enjoyed by viewers of all ages, whether they're 6 or 76!

Plastic has become ubiquitous. Impressive, since we'd been living without them for centuries! We have grown dependent on plastics in many ways. The production industry uses it to connect the parts that make machinery: our trillions of toilet bowls need it, let alone wash machines, computers, toothbrushes, pens and traffic lights. Can you imagine that plastic was accidentally invented for the purpose of making billiard balls? Though, its inventor had used something now called guncotton, which led to a rather explosive game of pool. In the end, the first plastic was discovered when someone witnessed how Southeast Asian farmers used the poop of a little beetle, called shellac, to preserve wood. When looking for a substitute, Leo Beakeland created "Bakelite" and that substance turned out to be the first plastic. Nylon followed, the first man-made synthetic plastic, developed by Dupont to replace silk. Nylon isn't that difficult to make yourself, amazingly. During WW2 all nylon production went into the manufacturing of parachutes, leading Dupont and others to stop producing pantyhose. It led to true nylon riots. Plastics were plain out popular. Indeed, the age of plastic had only just begun. But plastic is made with oil and is hard to break down, which calls for a solution. A company in the US is creating a bioplastic grown inside microorganisms. In fact - soon they'll have plants cultivating plastic… plastic grown in the field? Now that is quirky!

Pēc viesuļvētras Katrīna postījumiem Ņūorleānas "Saints" uzvara Superbowl pacēla pilsētas noskaņojumu. Tomēr pēc spēles izcēlās skandāls par atlīdzībām, kas tika izmaksātas par pretinieku ievainošanu, radot jautājumus par notikušo.

Astoņdesmito gadu beigu boksa pasauli bija pārņēmusi alkatība un korupcija. Krāpnieks Riks Pārkers piespieda iesācēju Timu Andersonu uz cīņu pret NFL zvaigzni Marku Gastino. Andersona atteikšanās noveda pie traģiskām sekām.

Kubas beisbola zvaigznes Jasiela Puiga bīstamā emigrēšana, lai īstenotu savu sapni par MBL - izvairoties no kontrabandistiem, karteļiem, ķīlnieku situācijām un satriecošām nodevībām, beigu beigās kļūstot par "Dodgers" sensāciju.
Skaista divu bērnu māte Kristāla Makdauela pazuda viesuļvētras Hārvija laikā, kas plosās Hjūstonā. Novērošanas kameru video aizved izmeklētājus pie viņas slepkavas.

Glamūrīgā bijusī modele Samira Fraša dzīvoja greznu dzīvi, īrējot vairākas mājas un pārvietojoties ar luksusa automašīnām. Līdz notika traģēdija. Divu bērnu māte tika atrasta mirusi sava peldbaseina gultnē, un abi viņas bērni bija pazuduši no mājas.

Pirmās 48 stundas pēc nozieguma izdarīšanas izmeklētāju darbā ir visbūtiskākās, jo tieši šis laikposms nereti izšķir to, vai noziegums tiks atšķetināts. Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo sarūk uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.

Rendijs un Katalina cenšas panākt, lai Erls no saraksta beidzot izsvītro "atmest smēķēšanu". Viņi arī aizved viņu pie Donija Džounsa, kurš atsēdēja divus gadus par Erla noziegumu. Džoja mēģina nogalināt Erlu, lai mantotu naudu.
Lai svītrotu no sava saraksta vēl vienu netaisnību, Erls apņemas panākt, ka brālim Rendijam tiek vidusskolā liegtais futbols.
Erls reiz viltoja savu nāvi, lai izkļūtu no attiecībām. Tagad viņš vēlas atklāties un pastāstīt meitenei par savu viltību.
Erls vēlas atvainoties visiem, kas apsmieti par akcentu, mācot imigrantiem angļu valodu.
Erls vēlas kompensēt Džojas greznās figūriņas salauzšanu, to nomainot. Tomēr to nevar nopirkt, jo tā ir balva mātes un meitas skaistumkonkursā.

Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki. Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties – nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes –, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks – no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.
Draudzenes apmeklē Stellas bāra atklāšanu un pieņem svarīgus lēmumus par savām attiecībām, karjeru un nākotni. Džūlsa sarūpē Medisonei dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu.

Džūlsa Vailija pēdējos piecus gadus ir pilnībā iegrimusi savās attiecībās. Kad draugs viņu negaidīti pamet, Džūlsa saprot, ka viņas draudzība ar citām sievietēm ir sairusi, un viņa nolemj rīkot meiteņu vakaru, lai mēģinātu to labot.

Мечту скромной медсестры Ксении о прекрасной жизни в новом месте с любимым человеком неожиданно разбивает известие о тяжелой болезни ее мамы. Ксения вынуждена отменить свой переезд за границу и искать деньги на дорогостоящую операцию. Оставшись одна, без жилья и без работы, она пытается сделать все, что в ее силах. Неожиданно она получает предложение стать сиделкой в доме обеспеченной вдовы Ольги Болговой. Ксения с радостью принимает это предложение. Новый дом и его обитатели поначалу пугают ее, но постепенно Ксения привыкает. Она пытается наладить жизнь в доме и помочь выздороветь Ольге. К ее радости, ей начинает это удаваться. Но на самом деле Ксения еще не понимает, в какую опасную игру ее втянули…

Главная героиня Светлана мечтает стать актрисой и покорить большую сцену. Она упорно готовится к поступлению в театральное училище, но из-за волнения не сдает экзамены и заваливает главное выступление. Неожиданно слова поддержки девушке высказывает ее кумир - актер Артем Бовенко, который был членом приемной комиссии. Он отметил, что у Светланы есть талант и ей обязательно стоит попробовать вступить в следующем году. Но, увы, жизнь пошла по другому сценарию. Она выходит замуж и рожает ребенка. А через некоторое время муж оставляет ее с маленькой дочкой на руках. Какие теперь могут быть мечты об актерской профессии, когда нужно самостоятельно обеспечивать ребенка? Поэтому Светлана осваивает профессию риэлтора.

Максим - успешный гонщик, на счету которого много побед. Несмотря на свою популярность, мужчина не испытывает подлинного счастья. Изнутри его съедает личная трагедия. Когда-то у гонщика была жена, с которой они счастливо воспитывали ребенка. Однако, их постигло несчастье - любимый сын погиб в ДТП. Супруги планировали повторно зачать ребенка при помощи ЭКО. Но в самый ответственный момент жена Максима бросила его. Пережив потрясение, мужчина согласился оставить свой биологический материал другой женщине. Тогда он еще не знал, что через 10 лет он встретится с биологическим сыном Пашей. Что ждет отца и сына? Как изменятся их жизни?

Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

An weird but witty old woman is forced to deal with an ambiguous future after her country, family and the entire system of values are ruined. She is trying to solve her existential problems catching d trying to sell a rewarded war criminal as he was a rabbit in a wood. The only thing she did not know if he is really him.

Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.
A distant, slightly dysfunctional family is brought closer together when the father's long-estranged Uncle Nino comes from Italy to Chicago for a surprise visit.

Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

p.t: The Old Man and the Gun
p.d: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.
A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

62 year old Jeremiah Wilson is truly the Train Master of Willamette Western Railroad. He lives, breaths, and eats railroad. When Brett Banner, 32 year old heir to New York Eastern talks his dad into purchasing Willamette Western, there is immediately a clash between himself and Jeremiah. Jeremiah is fired by Brett two years from retirement and turns into a angry, depressed grandfather. When Brett's nine year old son Justin realizes Jeremiah's grandson Thomas can drive a locomotive, he kidnaps and holds Thomas' favorite dinosaur ransom. Justin, Thomas and 3 other children board an old engine in for repairs and accidentally turns it into runaway engine causing a chain reaction of events.

Viņi ieplāno ceļojumu apkārt Indijai, cerot, ka šāda ekstrēma un piedzīvojumiem bagāta tūre nāks par labu ne tikai viņu savstarpējām attiecībām, bet arī palīdzēs katram ieklausīties sevī pašā. Tomēr viņu garīgā misija pārtop par nekontrolējamu uzdzīvi, kas vainagojas ar bezcerīgu situāciju tuksneša vidū, kur viņi attopas vieni, bet ar vienpadsmit čemodāniem, printeri un laminējamo iekārtu. Nu viņi ir spiesti uzsākt jaunu, neplānotu braucienu.

Viesnīca "Diženā Budapešta" stāsta par Eiropā slavenās viesnīcas leģendārā viesmīļa Gustava H un portjē Zero Mustafa piedzīvojumiem. Viesnīcas darbinieki kļūst par lieciniekiem nenovērtējamas renesanses gleznas zādzībai, kādas bagātas ģimenes cīņai par milzīgu mantojumu un dramatiskām izmaiņām, kuras notiek Eiropā periodā starp diviem pasaules kariem.

Lai gan Amanda un Davsons nāk no dažādiem sociālajiem slāņiem, viņu mīlasstāsts, kurš sācies jau pusaudžu vecumā, ir pierādījums tam, ka dvēseļu radinieki eksistē. Kāds negadījums jauniešus izšķir. Paiet teju 20 gadi, kad nejaušība viņus atkal saved kopā. Amanda ir nelaimīgi precējusies un sirds dziļumos joprojām nespēj piedot Davsonam, ka viņš no viņas reiz atteicies, tomēr skaidrs ir viens - intensīvās jūtas, kas piedzīvotas jaunībā, nav mazinājušās, bet tikai pieņēmušās spēkā. Vai dvēseles radiniekiem liktenis lēmis būt kopā?

Vudija Allena 50. kinofilmas darbība norisinās skaistākajā un romantiskākajā Spānijas piekrastes pilsētā Sevastjanā, kura katru gadu pulcē kino industrijas pārstāvjus kino festivālā. Turp dodas arī kompleksu māktais rakstnieks Morts Rifkins, kurš ir aizrautīgs kino mīļotājs. Festivālā viņš pavada savu skaisto sievu Sjū, kura pilda jauna režisora publicistes pienākumus. Morts ir pārliecināts, ka ceļojums piešķils asumu attiecībās ar sievu, taču situāciju pamatīgi sarežģī sievas klients, kuru arī apbūrusi gan Spānijas dienvidu romantika... gan Morta sieva.
Stāsts par jaunu vīrieti, kurš nupat atbrīvots no cietuma par vardarbīgu noziegumu, ko viņš pastrādājis bērnībā.

Apjukušam dziedātājam dotas pāris dienas, lai sacerētu hitu, kas iekaros topu un kļūs par pusaudžu sensāciju. Lai gan viņš nekad mūžā nav sarakstījis pienācīgu dziesmu tekstu, viņā uzplaiksnī dzirksts ar neparastu jaunāku sievieti ar izcilu vārdu mākslu.

Romija un Mišela ir sirdsdraudzenes jau no bērnības, bet kopš vidusskolas beigšanas viņas īrē kopīgu dzīvokli. Uzzinājušas, ka tuvojas vidusskolas salidojums, draudzenes aptver, ka viņām nav ar ko palielīties bijušo skolas biedru priekšā. Lai kompensētu sasniegumu trūkumu, jaunās dāmas nolemj izlikties par veiksmīgam uzņēmējām. Salidojumā dāmītes satiek arī savas mūžsenās sāncenses, kas drīz vien atklāj, ka Romija un Mišela melo par savu dzīvi...

Džons grasās drīzumā pamest savu dzimto pilsētu, jo viņu gaida armija. Kā par spīti, tieši pēdējās dienās pirms aizbraukšanas viņš iepazīstas ar studenti, vārdā Savanna, kura ieradusies pilsētiņā. Abu mīlestība ir negaidīta, taču spēcīga. Tomēr vai tā spēs izturēt šķiršanos un Džona nosūtījumu uz vietu, no kuras ir maz iespēju atgriezties?
Muhameda Ali biogrāfija, pievēršoties viņa triumfiem un pretrunām.

Jaunās māmiņas Stefānijas un noslēpumainās Emīlijas dēli mācās vienā pamatskolā, tas nejauši saved kopā abas nepazīstamās sievietes. Kādu dienu Stefānija saņem zvanu no nesen iegūtās draudzenes, kura vēršas pie viņas ar nelielu lūgumu, bet pēc tam mistiski pazūd. Vēlēdamies noskaidrot patiesību, Stefānija nolemj veikt savu izmeklēšanu. Soli pa solim viņa tuvojas šaušalīgajai patiesībai, kas glabā biedējošus noslēpumus. Kas patiesībā notika ar Emīliju? Galvenās lomas atveido Anna Kendrika, Bleika Laivlija, Henrijs Goldings un Endrū Ranelss.

Vienkāršs gājiens uz banku, lai izņemtu skaidru naudu, Tripam beidzas ar nokļūšanu gūstā pie divām bankas aplaupītāju bandām vienlaikus. Viņam nākas veikt viltīgus un drosmīgus trikus, lai atbrīvotu ķīlniekus un iekarotu klusībā mīlētās bankas darbinieces sirdi. Taču nekas nav tā, kā tas sākumā izskatās, un pārsteigumi seko viens otram.

Every region has its own local culture and flavor. One of the best ways for a traveler to immerse him or herself in new destinations is to taste these unique dishes. This taste exploration allows even the strictest of dieters the freedom to indulge. In the new series, Travel Channel's Man v. Food, host Adam Richman sets out to travel the country in search of the best places to do some serious indulging. Starting season 5, Casey Webb took over as host.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Ree Drummond is hosting a cooking and eating get-together with her Oklahoma City Thunder gal friends. They're teaming up to cook a great spring menu of White Spinach Artichoke Lasagna with a Butternut and Kale Salad -- two easy dishes perfect for effortless entertaining. Afterward, they're sipping Thunder Margaritas in the team colors and wrapping up the party with self-assembly Boozy Berries and Cream.

Ree Drummond is sharing a trio of dinners for two—for her daughter, Paige, for the freezer, and for her other half, Ladd. Ree's mother-daughter dinner is an all-in-one Spatchcock Chicken Sheet Pan Supper. Next, her layered Loaf Pan Lasagna is perfectly portioned for two and just the thing for stocking up the freezer. Then, Ree and Ladd cook up frontier-style Steak Frites and Oven Fries with Ladd's own Lemon and Pepper Seasoning and Easy Hollandaise.

There's a flurry of activity on the ranch for a calf working, so Ree Drummond is preparing a well-deserved lunch at the lodge for the cowboy crew. She makes a crispy-coated ranch favorite, Chicken Fried Steak Sliders piled on beautiful, warm Buttermilk Biscuits and served with Buttermilk Gravy. Her Perfect Fried Potatoes are a tasty and filling side dish. For dessert, Ree makes Cherry Pie Cookie Bars, the perfect sweet treat for the crew to enjoy as they head back to work.
Elizabeth uses fresh strawberries to make and preserve homemade jam. Then, she whips up a strawberry shortcake with ginger whipped cream for a family night.
Elizabeth prepares meatloaf and apple empanadas for her annual cider party.
Esther Choi shares great recipes for the family, including gyeran-mari, sweet potato pancakes, and nurungji chicken.
Esther Choi makes some favourite Korean classics - Korean barbecue of LA Kalbi with Ssamjangand and a hot pot: bulgogi mushroom jeongol.
Chef Maneet Chauhan shares her personal spice blend for masala Chai and makes the popular savoury and crunchy snack, Murukku.
Maneet Chauhan makes crispy spinach and onion pakoras and saag paneer, a satisfying vegetarian meal made from curdled paneer cheese and bright greens.
The reigning champ faces Torrece "Chef T" Gregoire and Joe Flamm as the chefs tackle fan-favourite flavors in a high-stakes culinary showdown.

Panda, vārdā Po, strādā nūdeļu restorānā. Viņš sapņo kļūt par slavenu kungfu meistaru, jo ir kaislīgs kungfu fans, taču Po ķermeņa apmēri īsti neatbilst šim sapnim. Un ja tā pavisam godīgi, – pandas ir slinkākie dzīvnieki visā Ķīnā. Tomēr, kad pilsētai tuvojas ienaidnieks, visu cerības balstās senā pareģojumā par kādu Po, kurš izrādīsies "izredzētais" un visus izglābs. Austrumu cīņu meistariem nāksies bruņoties ar milzu pacietību, lai slinkuma maisu Po padarītu par kungfu cīkstoni.

Pīters Pārkers joprojām sēro par sava mentora Tonija Starka zaudējumu un cenšas atgriezties parasta pusaudža dzīvē. Viņš kopā ar klasesbiedriem dodas skolas ekskursijā uz Eiropu, cerot uz laiku nolikt malā supervaroņa kostīmu, izbaudīt Venēciju, Parīzi un Londonu, un beidzot atzīties mīlestībā Emdžejai. Tomēr Pītera plāni sabrūk, kad viņu uzmeklē Niks Furijs. Eiropas pilsētām uzbrūk noslēpumaini radījumi Elementāļi, kas spēj izsaukt dabas katastrofas. Pīteram nākas apvienot spēkus ar jaunu sabiedroto no paralēlās dimensijas Kventinu Beku, kuru pasaule iepazīst kā Misterio. Pīteram ir jāizlemj, vai viņš ir gatavs kļūt par nākamo "Dzelzs vīru" pasaulē, kas ir neatgriezeniski mainījusies, un jāmācās atšķirt patiesību no ilūzijas.

Animācijas filmas "Ledus laikmets" veidotāji sagatavojuši jaunu piedzīvojumu komēdiju visai ģimenei. Blū ir pieradināts papagailis, kas tā arī nav iemācījies lidot. Viņš visu mūžu baudījis ērtības Minesotas štata mazpilsētā, kur dzīvo kopā ar savu saimnieci Lindu. Blū un Linda ir pārliecināti, ka viņš ir pēdējais savas sugas pārstāvis, taču, kad izrādās, ka Riodežaneiro dzīvo arī krāšņā Džuela, abi dodas uz turieni, lai viņu uzmeklētu. Jau drīz vien pēc ierašanās Blū un Džuelu nolaupa eksotisko dzīvnieku tirgotāji. Taču Džuela ir radusi pie dzīves pilsētas ielās, un ar vairāku runājošu putnu palīdzību viņiem izdodas tikt brīvībā. Draugu un Džuelas iedrošināts, Blū beidzot iemācīsies lidot, lai varētu atgriezties pie savas labākās draudzenes Lindas.

Klusā, bet ļoti mūsdienīgā pilsētā Robo notiek kas neredzēts un nedzirdēts. Mērs Frenks ir zaudējis prātu. Viņa plāns neiekļaujas nekādos rāmjos. Tikai paklausieties! Viņam apnikuši cilvēki un dzīvnieki, tāpēc viņš savā prātā perina plānu – visus iedzīvotājus un mājdzīvniekus izdzīt no pilsētas un viņu mājas atdot robotiem! Kad suns bez pajumtes Rodžers uzzina šo jaunumu, viņam visas spalvas saceļas stāvus. Šis Robins Huds daudz laika pavadījis uz ielas, nočiepis dažu labu gardas desas luņķi, lai to atdotu vājākiem dzīvniekiem, un nu jūt, ka mēra plāns pie laba gala nenovedīs. No pilsētas pazudīs dzīvība! Atgriezies no jaukas pastaigas kopā ar daiļo Siāmas kaķenīti Bellu, Rodžers šausmās sastingst. Roboti sagrāvuši viņa vienīgo būdiņu! Mukdams, ko nagi nes, Rodžers piepeši satiek labsirdīgo robotu Bobu, kuram arī mēra nodoms šķiet briesmīgs. Ir jārīkojas! Jāglābjas pašiem un jāglābj citi. Ja nekas netiks darīts, greznā mājdzīvnieku viesnīca būs briesmās. Nenojauzdami nekā ļauna, tajā mitinās daudzi četrkājainie.

Visnozīmīgākā cīņa Zirnekļcilvēkam notiek viņā pašā – bezgalīga sacensība starp Pītera Parkera ikdienišķiem pienākumiem un Zirnekļcilvēka milzīgo atbildību. Taču kulta blokbastera turpinājumā mēs noskaidrosim, ka nākotnē Pīteru gaida daudz nopietnāka kauja un būt Zirnekļcilvēkam joprojām ir tikpat forši.

Ceļojums vienā no krāšņākajiem Eiropas vilcieniem pārvēršas vienā no sarežģītākajām un visaizraujošākajām mīklām kriminālistikas vēsturē. Savā kupejā miris tiek atrasts noslēpumainais amerikāņu miljonārs Rečets un nav šaubu, ka slepkava ir viens no pasažieriem. Kamēr puteņa dēļ vilciens ir apstājies un nošķirts no ārējās pasaules, detektīvam Eriklam Puaro ir jānoskaidro slepkava, pirms tas uzbruks atkal.

No dienesta atvaļinātā kareive Džoja strādā par logu mazgātāju 300 metru augstumā pie kāda Londonas debesskrāpja ārsienas, kad ēkas iekšienē radikālu aktīvistu grupa Markusa (Klaivs Ouens) vadībā sagrābj par ķīlniekiem labdarības pasākuma viesus, lai atmaskotu starptautiska enerģētikas koncerna korupciju. Tomēr ekstrēmistam Noā ar patiesības atklāšanu vien nepietiek. Viņš un viņa uzticamākie sekotāji ir gatavi nogalināt ikvienu ēkā esošo, lai pasaulei nodotu savu anarhistisko vēstījumu. Bez policijas atbalsta Džoja ir spiesta rīkoties pati, lai glābtu ķīlniekus un apturētu asiņaino plānu.

Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".
Hetere sastop Karlu, ar kuru nav tikusies gadiem ilgi, un piedāvā viņai ko tik negaidītu, ka tas varētu mainīt abu dzīves uz visiem laikiem.

Makss (Luiss Sīkejs) ir enerģisks un sajūsmināts Džeka Rasela terjers, kurš dzīvo Manhetenas dzīvoklī kopā ar īpašnieci Keitiju (Elija Kempere). Taču viņa laimīgā dzīve pārtrūkst, kad saimniece pieņem jaunu suni Grāfu (Ēriks Stounstrīts). Makss apņemas atgūt saimnieces uzmanību tikai sev un mēģina Grāfu atstāt kādā sānielā, taču viņus ielenc kaķu banda, kuru vada Ozons (Stīvs Kūgans). Viņi tik tikko izglābj savas dzīvības, kad nākas saskarties ar pamesto dzīvnieku armijas niknumu apburošā, bet psihiski nelīdzsvarotā truša Sniegapikas (Kevins Hārts) vadībā. Šis ir Ņujorkas piedzīvojums, kurš liek Maksam un Grāfam izvērtēt savu sacensību un mēģināt izjaukt Sniegapikas atriebes plānu pret visiem dzīvnieku īpašniekiem Ņujorkā.

Uz Noasa šķirsta kļūst nemierīgi – kuģis pārāk ilgi kuģo pa jūru, zeme nav redzama un pārtikas krājumi sarūk arvien vairāk. Kādu dienu ceļotāji patiešām atklāj salu, taču uz tās ir aktīvs vulkāns, un arī salas iedzīvotāji nav visai viesmīlīgi.

Hloja un viņas mamma pārvācas – jau ATKAL! Turklāt viņas pārvācas uz necilu, vecu māju, kas pilna ar dārza rūķiem. Drīz Hloja gan atklāj, ka šī māja slēpj biedējošu noslēpumu. Kādu dienu pēc skolas Hloja kopā ar kaimiņu Liamu atklāj, ka rūķi patiesībā ir dzīvi! Kā izrādās, jau gadiem rūķi ir sargājuši planētu no draudīgiem maziem monstriem, kuri iebrukuši mājā caur portālu, kas ved uz citu pasauli. Kad vienīgais līdzeklis, kas varētu palīdzēt uzveikt monstrus, skolā nonāk nepareizajās rokās, Hlojai un Liamam jāsadarbojas ar rūķiem, lai cīnītos pret mazo negantnieku iebrukumu un glābtu pasauli!

Korejiešu amerikāņu ģimene pārceļas uz fermu Arkanzasā, meklējot paši savu amerikāņu sapni. Grūtības, ar ko viņi sastopas jaunās dzīves sākumā, atklāj arī ģimenes saišu spēku un to, kas patiesībā ir mājas.
Džonijs ar draugiem uzsāk slepenu misiju, lai glābtu ciemu no valzirga Oto ļaunajiem plāniem.

Tafiti, jauns surikāts, sākumā noraida draudzību ar Bristlsu, krūmu cūku. Kad viņa vectēvam iekož čūska, Tafiti dodas ceļā, lai atrastu ziedu, kas varētu vectētiņu izārstēt. Bristlss vēlas pierādīt, ka piedzīvojumi vienmēr ir labāki kopā ar draugiem.

La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.
Watch all the action from the Scottish Premier League.

PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

p.d: Brian and Yoonah are looking for a conveniently located vacation home so they can easily get away from their busy lives and schedules. Matt Blashaw shows the couple several retreats close to the water, with large enough living spaces where their family of six can congregate for some quality time. Will the family opt for a bay side beauty or overlook a funky floor plan to get the beach front house they always wanted?

Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

In her interior design show One of a Kind Grace focuses on her client's stories instead of beautiful Pinterest boards, listens to their personal wishes and hears their desires, so the completed projects turn out to be exactly what people want.

After raising a family in Pennsylvania, a couple looks to relocate to the warm weather of his native Dominican Republic.
After a romantic getaway, a couple knew the Florida Keys was the place to find their paradise home. They're looking for a waterfront property.
Kamohai and Tristyn rebuild hope after the Lahaina fires.

With a baby due in a matter of months, Daphne and Ian take on a challenge as they race to transform their historic three-story Dove Tower into a luxury bridal suite, creating the perfect wedding retreat far from the cries of a newborn.

We Bought A Funeral Home is an eerie new series that will unearth an unconventional side of the home renovation realm. The six episodes will document the quirky journey of Heather and Arryn Blumberg and their two kids, Rafferty and Noa, who trade in big city life to buy, renovate and design a 12,000-square-foot, 1800s Victorian funeral home in the small town of Dresden, Ontario.
Clint Harp helps transform a timber-framed barn in Carlisle, New York. It is taken down and rebuilt as a boathouse on the Brazos River in Waco, Texas.

Maddie Moate explores unique homes across the globe which reflect their owners' personalities, passions and philosophies for life. These visionaries dared to dream, build, and live differently, challenging the way we see home.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

The Great Pyramid of Giza remains as one of the biggest mysteries of the world, with evidence suggesting it may have been an ancient power plant. Could these structures hold the key to unraveling the truth about humanity's extraterrestrial past?

Are reports of a strange swirling vortex with a brilliant white center in the skies over Oklahoma proof of a genuine UFO? Does a video claimed to be discovered sealed in Vatican archives, show a real case of demonic possession? What is the mysterious looking creature discovered by a woman in Russia while wading in the waters in the town of Sosnovy Bor? Do large unidentified footprints found by Alaskan wildlife experts belong to a Yeti? Tony Harris and his team of experts examine the clues and make a determination about the validity of what we're seeing.

Shady Secrets. Some secrets refuse to stay buried. Whether it's illicit cargo in a frozen lake, a stolen masterpiece worth millions, or a brothel hidden in the shadow of the Capitol - the truth always resurfaces.

Remember when "everybody's doing it" was reason enough to dive in headfirst? From gravity-defying flagpole sitting and phone booth cramming, to pet skunks and goldfish gulpers, we reveal the wildest crazes that once swept the nation.

Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

p.t: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
p.d: Near the end of the third century, civil war has torn the empire apart and left its borders vulnerable to barbarian invasion. Romans living on the eastern and western frontiers, far from Rome, are left to defend themselves, which they do by building their own armies and naming their own emperors. As the Empire divides against itself, one extraordinary man rises from the rank of soldier to become emperor in Rome. His name is Aurelian, and with an unshakeable trust in the sun god, he fights back the barbarians who by now threaten Rome itself. Once he secures the great city, Aurelian pursues the rulers of the splinter empires: an eastern warrior queen and a proud western general. Defeating both, he reunites the empire in five short years, earning the title Restorer of the World. For a moment there is peace. But in 275 AD Aurelian is assassinated; his death is mourned by Romans across the empire, who know too well the scarcity of greatness in their rulers.

It has been called the key to the universe and possibly the most important scientific breakthrough of all time. Could the so-called "God Particle" reveal the truth about our origins? And might clues to its significance have been left here on Earth thousands of years ago by extraterrestrial beings? The age-old question, "where did we come from?" remains a mystery, but in 2012, scientists at CERN laboratory announced the discovery of the "God Particle"--the subatomic particle that is believed to give mass to matter--and offers a closer understanding of just how the universe began. The discovery seemingly pitted science against religion. But could science and religion actually be kindred spirits? Many ancient religions and mythologies describe the origins of the universe in ways very similar to today's scientific explanations and proclaim that this information was given to them by otherworldy beings.

From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.
